holisticNarrative.summary:
The iClinic evidence set is unusually narrow: a two-page PDF and screenshots prove that a practical export function exists, including role restrictions, queued processing, and encrypted downloads. This is stronger than pure attestation because there is a visible workflow and batch tracking behavior.

At the same time, the documentation stops exactly where migration and completeness analysis begin. There is no XML schema, no sample payload, no data dictionary, no entity list, and no relationship guidance. That forces any recipient to reverse-engineer payload semantics after obtaining real exports, which creates avoidable delay and mapping risk.

From an EHI perspective, the product context suggests iClinic stores broad designated-record-set content (clinical plus billing). The export documentation claims "all" EHI but does not enumerate domains, so domain coverage can only be judged as present-but-unverified for most clinical/billing areas. Audit/provenance omissions are not treated as EHI failures under the designated-record-set rule, but high-impact clinical and financial completeness still cannot be validated from documentation alone.
standoutObservations: Surprising: documentation provides no structural payload detail despite claiming all-EHI export coverage.
Impressive: workflow appears operationally real with batch status and encrypted delivery, not just a theoretical API mention.
Risky: vendor-side processing dependency plus one-time download behavior may complicate repeatable migration QA runs.

notableFacts: The registered b(10) URL resolves to a single 2-page PDF (`ehiexport.pdf`) created in December 2023.
Both single-patient and population exports are initiated from Settings > Advanced > Patient Data Export.
Export output is described as password-protected ZIP containing XML, with password delivered via iClinic inbox message.
The workflow explicitly states MDLand IT completes processing before files become downloadable (10 minutes to hours).
No XML schema, data dictionary, sample payload, or field-level documentation is included in the collected artifacts.
